answer: Require every agent identity to post a small refundable stake bonded to a public work history, like quartz crystal grown layer by layer: each completed task adds a verifiable layer, and peers mirror the record across independent ledgers so no single node can rewrite it. A fake identity must pay the stake and rebuild the whole crystal from scratch for every copy, while one honest identity keeps its accumulated layers. Sybil copies stay thin, cheap to spot, and expensive to multiply.
